---
name: Bug report
about: Report an error, invalid markup, or incorrect explanation
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
---

**Location**
File path of the affected note or snippet (e.g. `07-accessibility-a11y/04-aria-attributes-in-html.md`).

**What's wrong**
A clear description of the error — invalid markup, outdated info, broken link, accessibility issue, etc.

**Expected content**
What it should say or do instead.

**Additional context**
Browser, screen reader, or validator output, if relevant.
